dialogs.text: I'm here about this missing package...
Yeah, this one's mine. Someone from the Children of Echoes wanted to purchase paints, but couldn't tell me what colors he wanted to save his life.
That's why I sent him a package with several small bottles of paint in it — so he could get his preferences straight before he next shows up.
I'll get this resent — better that than him coming over here with his ridiculous reference requests...
Ah, right. This is for you. Thanks for getting this package back to me.
I'm here about this missing package...
I'm here about this missing letter...
Huh? Yeah, this is my order. Didn't think it would meet with such bad luck...
Oh well. I'll just have to write another later. This isn't super urgent, anyway.
Anyway, thanks for bringing the letter back to me. You're sweating all over — here, have a drink on me.
I'm here about this missing letter...
I'm here about this missing package...
Yeah, this one's mine — it's the package I sent out!
Oh, thank goodness, I thought I'd sent it off to the wrong address... I'd be smoked if that was the case!
Thank you, truly! Please, take these.
Also, uh... Could you not tell Ms. Cheven about this? I'm begging you!
I'm here about this missing package...
I'm here about this missing letter...
...Yes. This letter's mine. Thank you.
I'll write a new one soon. Then I'll get someone to send it to the Flower-Feather Clan.
...I hope this next one makes it there safely.
Here, you've earned this.
I'm here about this missing letter...
Looks like... it's for Acat.
...The packaging's broken. If we resend it as-is, the whole item might get ruined.
I still need to sort out the packages in the store, so could you help me send this to her?
She's the owner of Frida's Palette. Don't worry, you couldn't miss her shop's sign even if you tried.
About the package we're looking for...
This... looks like Chanca's handwriting.
If I had to guess, this must be another order invoice. The packaging here is broken — there's no way we can deliver it this way. This letter shall have to be returned.
I still need to sort out the packages in the store, so could you help send this back to Chanca in my stead?
She's the owner of the Weary Inn near the Stadium of the Sacred Flame. You can't miss it.
About the package we're looking for...
Muhuru's Gemporium... Imix? Agh, this is an invoice she sent out, isn't it?
If this gets lost in transit, that kid's going to get an earful from Ms. Cheven.
I still need to sort out the packages in the store, so could you help me send this back to Imix?
Muhuru's Gemporium is in the Children of Echoes' lands — and it's an easy find if ever there was one.
About the package we're looking for...
...This letter's from Tirda, if I'm not mistaken.
Was she trying to get it sent to her tribe? But it's a mess now... We're going to have to return it.
I still need to sort out the packages in the store, so could you help get this back to Tirda in my stead?
She sings at the Golden Dusk. You'll find her in no time.
About the package we're looking for...
I picked this up earlier...
Did you, now? Some idiot must have lost it along the way again. Let me see...
